name: Roast Tomato & Red Pepper Soup
description: Roasting the vegetables first gives this soup a deep, sweet flavour. Blend until silky and serve with crusty bread.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the tomatoes, peppers, onion and garlic with the oil and oregano in a large roasting tin and season.
Roast for 40 minutes until soft and catching at the edges.
Squeeze the garlic from its skins, then tip everything into a pan with the stock and vinegar. Bring to a simmer.
Blend until smooth, check the seasoning and serve with bread.
